units.function: CLI smoke and boundary tests for company portability, adapter administration, asset transfer and company skill lifecycle commands.
units.dependencyDirection: Imports CLI command registration and one export-path resolver, mocks fetch, and uses temporary local files without invoking server services or persistence.
units.keyDataModels: Company/skill/asset IDs, adapter keys, payload JSON, multipart image upload and export output path.
units.lifecycle: Invokes 37 commands, compares method/URL pairs, checks upload MIME inference and rejects a parent-directory export filename.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5. Path containment, percent-encoded adapter IDs and upload MIME get useful focused assertions; authorization, tenant denial, symlink/overwrite/content integrity, package/skill provenance, rollback, Secrets, errors and real side effects remain untested.
units.designRationale: Keep a broad administrative CLI aligned with REST routes while guarding one obvious portable-export traversal case.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe self-hosted portability and operator automation for Connectors, assets and governed capability packages.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the export containment, identifier encoding and multipart-type tests into stronger end-to-end contracts. Generate route parity from the canonical API and add provenance, signature, tenant, approval, idempotency, rollback, overwrite/symlink and evidence assertions.
units.responsibilityConflict: Destructive and supply-chain-sensitive actions are exercised with the same static board token as reads and never bind an accountable human, approved change set, artifact digest or resulting audit evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 5 passed via existing local binary
